property_summary: For any two fallback calls with 10 ether, if the second call has the same block.timestamp as the first, the reference contract reverts it (thus address(c).balance equals the first call's received ether and pastBlockTime equals that first timestamp), while the buggy contract accepts both calls (doubling the balance and updating pastBlockTime to that duplicate timestamp).
change_summary: Delete the require(block.timestamp > pastBlockTime) check, allowing fallback calls within the same block timestamp.
